written_by: development agent from the five catalog photos, before the first measured run; evaluator-only input (the author receives the request notes only)
identity_features: Round panto front in clear crystal acetate: the rims, bridge and endpieces are transparent (champagne-clear), the lens edges and the inner rim groove are visible through the acetate; the rim is thick (about 5 mm) and softly rounded
Simple arched saddle bridge, transparent, sitting low between the lenses; no keyhole
Flat, light brown flash-mirror lenses with a champagne-gold reflection, uniform in tone, filling the round rims; a small grey 'TOM FORD' print in the upper outer area of the right lens

Temples in clear crystal acetate, wide at the hinge and tapering to the tip, with a thin gold metal core wire visible inside along their length (in the release the temples render opaque: judge their shape and the gold accents, not their transparency)
A flat gold-tone 'T' inlay on the outer face of each temple at the hinge; a small gold oval plaque on the underside near each tip
Small gold metal hinges visible through the crystal endpieces
Overall proportions: compact round front, lens height close to lens width, slim temples bending gently down behind the ear

conditions.photos: front, back, left side and a rear three-quarter view; one front three-quarter angled view held out from the author
conditions.translucency: the runtime renders the front translucent (see-through) and the temples opaque; a transparent front that shows the wearer's skin through the rim is the expected look
